name: Humility
overview: Scripture reveals humility as a profound recognition of our unworthiness and dependence on God, as seen in Abraham's acknowledgment of being 'dust and ashes' (Genesis 18:27) and Jacob's admission of unworthiness (Genesis 32:10). Humility fosters peace and reconciliation, exemplified by Abram's desire to avoid strife with Lot (Genesis 13:8), and it entrusts God with all outcomes, as Joseph declares that God will give Pharaoh an answer (Genesis 41:16). This virtue is foundational to godly character, inviting believers to trust God's sovereignty and to live with a heart that esteems others above self.
